reviews.author: Engineer Rohan
reviews.textAr: Installed a sandwich panel room in Al-Hamdaniya. Highly recommend — excellent quality, strong structure, clean finish, great price, very professional team, engineer Fawaz, timely delivery and great value for money.
reviews.textEn: Installed a sandwich panel room in Al-Hamdaniya. Highly recommend — excellent quality, strong structure, clean finish, great price, very professional team, engineer Fawaz, timely delivery and great value for money.

reviews.author: ابو سلطان
reviews.textAr: ممتازين، شغلهم نظيف ومنظم ودقيق، والفنيين محترفين وعندهم خبرة، وخدمتهم ممتازة. شكر خاص للمهندس فواز القحطاني. (تركيب غرف سندويش بنل)
reviews.textEn: Excellent — clean, organised and precise work. The technicians are professional and knowledgeable, and the service is top-notch. Special thanks to Engineer Fawaz Al-Qahtani. (Sandwich panel rooms)

reviews.author: مب مهم
reviews.textAr: ركبوا مظلة لكسان وطلعت جميلة، شغل مرتب وجودة عالية. العمال محترفين، وصاحب العمل يرد بسرعة ويحترم العميل. أنصح فيهم للجميع.
reviews.textEn: They installed a polycarbonate (Lexan) awning and it came out beautiful — tidy, high-quality work. The workers were professional, the owner responds quickly and respects the customer. I recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: marcos
reviews.textAr: شكراً على الجهد وحسن التعامل يا مهندس فواز، والنتيجة رائعة لمظلات بطول 12 متر.
reviews.textEn: Thank you for your hard work and the classy dealing, Engineer Fawaz, and the result is wonderful for 12m awnings.

reviews.author: بندر الزهراني
reviews.textAr: سرعة تركيب ودقه بالموعد وجوده منتج وحسن التعامل مع العميل
reviews.textEn: Fast installation, punctual scheduling, product quality, and respectful customer service.

reviews.author: وليد
reviews.textAr: أشكر الأخ فواز وفريق العمل مبدعين ومتقنين و فنانين الله يبارك لهم
reviews.textEn: I thank brother Fawaz and the team — creative, thorough, and skilled craftsmen. May God bless them.

reviews.author: أبو هيثم
reviews.textAr: عملت عندهم لكسان شغلهم مميز ومواعيدهم دقيقه شكرا للأستاذ فواز
reviews.textEn: I had Lexan work done with them — distinctive workmanship and accurate scheduling. Thanks to Mr. Fawaz.

reviews.author: محمد القحطاني
reviews.textEn: Very excellent, I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: عبدالله الشرعبي
reviews.textAr: كفووو واحسن معامله ومافيه تقصير والله يرزق من يشاء بغير حساب
reviews.textEn: Dependable and the best treatment with no shortcomings.
